        The root cause of the bug was the removal of a validation check for the instance name in the `ZooKeeperInstance` class. This check, which was present in version 1.5, ensured that the instance name provided by the user existed in the ZooKeeper setup. The introduction of the client configuration led to the omission of this check, allowing invalid instance names to be accepted, which could cause failures when trying to access resources associated with a non-existent instance.
        
        Commit message:
        ACCUMULO-3496 Enforce a valid instance name on ZKI creation.

1.5 contained a check, by calling getInstanceID(), which would throw
a RuntimeException if the user passed in an instance name which did
not exist in the zookeepers provided. The introduction of the client
configuration appears to have removed that check.

This change reintroduces that check and fixes any (now) broken tests.
